assessment: The authors propose that the covert latency of the stopping process, which allows for the stopping of movements in tasks like the stop-signal paradigm, can be measured through the offset latency of bursts of electromyographic (EMG) activity that is observable on trials in which no overt response (typically a button press) was produced. The investigation is extensive and systematic and will provide a helpful methodological resource that rigorously specifies this alternative measure of stopping.
